correctness.rationale: The input RESULT.md (blob da895240d8c50a2f3ad373f1a355d9d1dcf07284) explicitly presents the 16-vertex Cayley Shrikhande and 4x4 rook graphs, validates degree six, common-neighbor parameter two and local C6 vs two C3. The scale-two closed-radius-one Čech nerve is generated by each seven-vertex closed graph neighborhood. Independent fresh reconstruction from coordinate adjacency gives exact face vectors (16,120,400,512,336,112,16) and (16,120,464,536,336,112,16). Independent face-poset matching and complete reversed-Hasse directed topological sort verify 744/768 acyclic pairs and exactly one critical 0-cell plus 23/63 critical 2-cells. Forman gives integral wedges of 23 and 63 2-spheres, not just mod-two ranks. Brouwer–Van Maldeghem §10.6 supplies exactly two graph isomorphism classes at (16,6,2,2); no graph classification is inferred from enumeration alone.

originality.rationale: PASS best of knowledge: Matsushita Example 3.5 already gives the rook case K4 square K4 wedge 63 S2, and Brouwer–Van Maldeghem classifies the two graphs. A separate Resultary published theorem gives Ind(Shrikhande) wedge 23 S2; independence complex has only 200 faces, unlike the 1512-face closed-neighborhood nerve here, so equal sphere rank does not imply same simplicial complex or homotopy. No inspected source gives the Shrikhande radius-one closed-ball Čech 23-sphere calculation or cospectral topological contrast. Previte Chapter 3 lists selected D-neighborhood examples but no Shrikhande/rook entry; the full thesis search did not find either name. Some unindexed exact calculation could exist.
